浏览器不允许复制，请手动复制地址: Copy is unavailable. Please copy the address manually.
登录已结束，请重新登录: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
采集已停止，所有观看连接已断开: Capture stopped. All viewing connections are closed.
已切换到手动模式，正在启动采集: Switched to manual mode. Starting capture.
音视频由本机服务传输，: Audio and video stay on your server.
画面与声音，在你掌控的网络里实时发生。: Live sights and sounds, on the network you control.
让设备的每一个参数，都刚刚好。: Fine-tune every detail of your devices.
何时开放，何时安静，由你决定。: You decide when to go live and when to pause.
只把现场，分享给你信任的人。: Share your space only with people you trust.
从连接到采集，了解服务的每一次变化。: Follow every change, from connection to capture.
当前为演示测试源：画面由程序生成，声音为 440 Hz 测试音，未连接真实摄像头: Demo source: generated video and a 440 Hz test tone. No real camera or microphone is connected.
同一局域网内，输入地址并登录即可观看。: On the same LAN, open this address and sign in.
配置尚未加载，请刷新页面重试。: Settings have not loaded. Refresh the page to retry.
一个属于你的现场。: A space that belongs to you.
导入导出采集参数与定时计划，不包含密码或登录会话。: Import or export capture settings and schedules. Passwords and sessions are excluded.
配置文件不能超过 64 KB: Settings files must not exceed 64 KB
配置已载入草稿，请检查后点击保存并应用: Settings loaded as a draft. Review, then save and apply.
配置文件无效，原有配置未更改: Invalid file. Existing settings were not changed.
最近 200 条应用事件，包含采集故障、配置变更和登录记录。: The latest 200 events: capture errors, configuration changes and sign-ins.
把画面与声音留在你的网络。: Keep sights and sounds on your network.
打开浏览器，与此刻连接。: Open your browser. Connect to the moment.
私有连接 · 自主掌控 · 开源构建: Private access · Your control · Open source
使用管理员或只读访客账号登录。: Sign in as an administrator or a read-only guest.
没有默认密码。首次使用请在服务器运行: No default password. For initial setup, run on the server:
浏览器阻止了播放，请点击播放器后再试: Playback was blocked. Click the player and try again.
还没有可截图的视频画面: No video frame is available yet
此浏览器不支持本地录制: This browser does not support local recording
此浏览器没有可用的录制编码器: No compatible recording encoder is available
正在此设备本地录制；停止后下载，单次最多 10 分钟: Recording on this device. Download on stop; 10-minute limit.
无法启动本地录制，请更换浏览器或播放模式: Cannot start recording. Try another browser or playback mode.
开启采集后，画面和声音将在这里出现。: Start capture to see and hear your space.
连接成功后，将显示真实采集的音视频。: The captured stream will appear when connected.
此浏览器无法进入全屏: Fullscreen is unavailable in this browser
ICE 媒体连接的往返时间，不是端到端播放延迟: ICE round-trip time, not end-to-end playback latency
计划控制服务器的摄像头与麦克风采集。停止时会释放设备，也会中断所有正在观看的连接: Schedules control camera and microphone capture. Stopping releases devices and closes all viewing connections.
由管理员开启或停止: Started or stopped by an admin
使用 IANA 时区，例如 Asia/Shanghai、Europe/Londo: Use an IANA time zone, e.g. Asia/Shanghai or Europe/London.
结束时间早于开始时间表示跨午夜，例如周一 22:00–06:00 会持续到周二早: An earlier end time crosses midnight: Monday 22:00–06:00 ends Tuesday morning. State is restored after a restart. This does not power off the server.
多个时段可以叠加。定时模式没有任何时段时，采集始终关闭。: Windows may overlap. With no windows, scheduled capture stays off.
还没有开放时段。为工作日、夜间或周末安排不同计划。: No windows yet. Add schedules for weekdays, nights or weekends.
已保存计划的下一次切换: Next change in the saved schedule
访问权限在服务器验证: Access is verified on the server
网页接口和 WebRTC 信令均需登录；修改密码或撤销会话，也会断开对应的媒体播: Both APIs and WebRTC signaling require login. Changing a password or revoking a session also disconnects its media playback.
访客可以观看和收听，无法修改采集参数、计划或管理员设置。账号固定为 viewer: Guests can watch and listen but cannot change settings or schedules. Username: viewer, with a separate password.
访客密码已更新，原有访客会话已结束: Guest password updated. Previous guest sessions ended.
至少 12 个字符。访客密码与管理员密码独立保存。: At least 12 characters. Stored separately from the admin password.
管理员账号：{{p0}}。修改后，所有管理员设备需要重新登录。: Admin: {{p0}}. All admin devices must sign in again after the change.
两次输入的新密码不一致: The new passwords do not match
密码已修改，请重新登录: Password changed. Please sign in again.
会话有效期 {{p0}} 小时。结束会话将同时结束该设备的媒体连接。: Sessions last {{p0}} hours. Ending a session also closes its media connections.
已启用 Secure Cookie，请通过 HTTPS 访问。: Secure cookies enabled. Access over HTTPS.
当前适用于可信局域网 HTTP 访问。密码登录保护访问权限，HTTP 本身不加密: HTTP is suitable only on a trusted LAN. Passwords control access, but HTTP does not encrypt login data. Use HTTPS on untrusted networks.
IP 白名单和域名由服务器环境变量配置。: IP allowlists and domain names are configured through server environment variables.
显示在所有观看设备的控制台中。: Shown in the console on all viewing devices.
选择设备支持的分辨率与帧率组合。保存后，现有观看设备会重新连接。: Choose a resolution and frame rate supported by your camera. Saving reconnects viewers.
列出编码器不代表硬件实际可用；失败时会显示错误，不会静默降级。: A listed encoder may not work on this hardware. Failures are shown; no silent fallback.
Opus 编码用于浏览器低延迟播放。采集增益影响所有观看者，播放器音量只影响当前: Opus is used for low-latency browser playback. Capture gain affects everyone; playback volume affects only this device.
0 dB 保持原始音量，正值会放大噪声。: 0 dB preserves the original volume. Positive values amplify noise too.
正值延后声音；负值延后画面。需要实际测量后调整。: Positive delays audio; negative delays video. Measure before adjusting.
使用 FFmpeg 频域降噪，可能改变音色。: FFmpeg spectral noise reduction may change the sound.
直接读取设备支持的亮度、曝光、对焦等控制项；这里的更改立即生效，断电后可能由设备: Reads supported brightness, exposure, focus and other controls. Changes apply immediately and may reset after power loss.
测试源没有硬件控制项。切换到 Linux 真机后，这里会显示设备实际支持的参数。: The test source has no hardware controls. On Linux, the camera’s real controls appear here.
配置已被其他页面修改，请重新加载后再保存: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload before saving.
服务暂时不可用，请检查运行状态和日志: Service unavailable. Check status and logs.
至少启用一种采集输入: Enable at least one capture input
开始和结束时间不能相同: Start and end times must differ
密码至少需要 12 个字符: Password must contain at least 12 characters
此浏览器不支持 WebRTC，请使用现代浏览器: WebRTC is unavailable. Use a modern browser.
未收到媒体数据，请检查 UDP/TCP 8189 端口和服务器地址: No media received. Check UDP/TCP 8189 and the server address.
流尚未就绪，或 WebRTC 协商失败，请检查采集状态: Stream unavailable or WebRTC negotiation failed. Check capture status.
该设备未报告此分辨率 / 帧率 / 输入格式组合，请先检查设备能力: This camera does not report this resolution, frame rate and format combination.
